name: Malta International Airport

runway.v: main runway 13/31, 3,350 m x 58 m (second runway 05/23, 2,373 m x 45 m)

hours.v: handling and fuelling 24 hours; airport administration Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00 local

ppr.v: every flight needs prior notification to MIA Airport Operations; a filed flight plan is not permission to operate
ppr.quote: All flights require prior notification to MIA Airport Operations.

handling.v: operators requesting an airport slot are expected to name their preferred ground handler
handling.quote: Operators requesting an airport slot at MIA are expected to indicate their preferred ground handler.

noise.v: engine ground runs at higher power not allowed 23:00-06:00 local; instrument approach training not allowed 00:00-05:00 local; runway preference 31 from 06:00 to 18:00 and 13 from 18:00 to 06:00 local

notes: AIP Malta read from the Transport Malta PDF effective 6 Aug 2026 (AIRAC AMDT 084/2026); AD 2 LMML pages dated 14 May 2026 (AMDT 082/2026), page 11 dated 6 Aug 2026. Transport Malta's AIP page lists a current edition effective 29 Oct 2026 and a future one effective 26 Nov 2026, but shows no link URL, so the newer editions were not read; check AD 2 LMML against them. No night curfew on movements found in AD 2.20-2.22 (only engine runs and training limits). AD 2.20 asks for an ATC slot only for some training and test flights; airport slot requests are covered in AD 2.5 (not recorded as a coordination level). IATA MLA not printed as a code (only inside SITA addresses).
